boundary: Fixed public/index.html, styles.css, app.js, lib/service.mjs and lib/supabase.mjs served at http://127.0.0.1:4196 in the Claude desktop built-in browser (Chromium). Only the supabase adapter transport is an in-process fake of Supabase Auth/PostgREST with switchable faults. Not live Supabase Auth, not Vercel, not HTTPS/Secure cookies.
method: Login through the real form; faults switched via GET /__fault; the page's own refresh button and dialogs were driven by in-page click() calls; DOM state read after each step. Cookie retention is evidenced by the next request succeeding without re-login (cookies are HttpOnly and not readable from the page).

checks.during: status='保存先へ接続できません。 未更新。 前回取得したログを表示しています。', rows/detail kept, workspace shown, viewer kept
checks.recovery: next refresh 200, new row, no re-login

checks.during: access treated as expired, refresh endpoint 500 -> 503, display kept
page reload during fault: status '保存先へ接続できません。 未更新。' (error style); login form and workspace both hidden; no retry or logout control
checks.recovery: page reload after fault cleared -> workspace with rows, same session

checks.detail: user endpoint rejecting every token (bad_jwt) after a successful refresh -> 401, cleared to login screen

detail dialog had been rendered (17 nodes) -> after refresh 'reject': rows 0, detail-body empty, workspace hidden, login shown, viewer cleared, status 'セッションが切れました。ログインしてください。'; GET /api/session afterwards 401 (cookies cleared)
checks.note: export dialog was closed by the auditor before the refresh, so export clearing on true rejection was not separately observed in the browser; covered by tests/auth-recovery.test.mjs
